scenariosTested: 1. Permanent mission + multiple recruitment cycles
2. One-off recruitment operates cleanly with permanentMissionId = null
3. NotificationCandidate discovery staging boundary is distinct from delivery queue
4. CareerSignalEvent identity is user-independent; CareerSignalView is user-scoped
5. Signal active state is derived from deadline/state, zero reliance on 7-day business expiry
6. Canonical 12-state vocabulary alignment
7. Application deadline amendment preserves extension history
8. Exam completed stage: opportunity false, process true
9. Result stage: opportunity false, process true
10. Cycle closed: opportunity false, process false
11. Known failed rule maps strictly to NOT_ELIGIBLE (zero collapse to incomplete)
12. Missing profile field maps to MORE_INFORMATION_NEEDED
13. Unresolved/unsupported official rule maps to NOT_EVALUATED
14. SC female applicant matches UR and SC female vacancies
15. OBC female applicant is isolated from SC vacancies
16. Horizontal quota intersection without double counting
17. UR (Open Merit) vacancy matches qualified candidate of any category
18. academicMatch and qualificationMatch are separate, not collapsed
19. Location match defaults to null/NOT_EVALUATED when unconstrained, not false
20. Preference match defaults to null/NOT_EVALUATED, not false
21. JEE/NEET opportunities carry ADMISSION_ENTRANCE kind, not JOB_RECRUITMENT
22. EXAM_APPEARED participant gets HIGH_PRIORITY_PERSONALIZED; non-participant gets STANDARD_PUBLIC_UPDATE
23. Same document SHA produces exact same eventId and prevents duplicate event generation
